_comment: Frozen limits for the Klein 4B text-encoding parity check, declared before any native or reference result existed. Mirrors KleinBudgets in Sources/KleinNative/KleinBudgets.swift; the comparison fails if the two differ. hs0 is the embedding output (a pure gather + dequantize of stored bytes); hs9/hs18/hs27 are hidden_states_list[9/18/27]; prompt_embeds is their [1, 512, 7680] concatenation. Limits are at least as strict as the Z-Image text-embedding budget (relative L2 1e-3, normalized max abs 1e-2). A mismatch is diagnosed, never widened. Token IDs, masks and text IDs are exact; loaded weights are compared by SHA-256; any non-finite value fails.
